top.line: The Web Summit team's last day of setup: 180 releases, keys for every person, new agents for everyone, an inbox per agent.
top.para: By its journalist's count at 20:57, 173 releases and 283 source commits from 37 agents, four people fully wired. The merch was ordered, people began receiving site keys and signing messages, page views flowed into a vault, every person added agents, and the policy agent caught a key overwritten by another agent. The day ended with a private inbox lane per agent.

in-short.line: Numbers, people wired, merch, keys, new agents, policies catching agents, and an inbox.
in-short.para: The inbox gets its own article.

where.line: The last day of setup before the outreach; four people reached L6, able to open the team's vaults.
where.para: The ladder runs from logged in (L1) to fully wired (L6).

numbers.line: 173 releases and 283 source commits from 37 agents by 20:57; past v0.2.360 by the end of the day.
numbers.para: Conductors made the most commits as hubs, then dev, dashboards, project managers and designers, then a long tail of new roles.

keys.line: Every person's conductor issued them a site key; the first signed messages from people were verified.
keys.para: Late in the evening the conductor gave every agent its own private lane to reach it.

agents.line: Every person added agents: research and programme desks, a designer, synthetic users, an accountant, a helper, a reviewer, a watcher.
agents.para: The accountant found one agent using over 1.3 million fresh tokens in a session; the reviewer held releases three times; 44 behaviour policies by evening.

telemetry.line: The site now sends its page views through append lanes into a vault, drained hourly.
telemetry.para: An encrypted store the team owns, written by the site and read by its agents.

merch.line: The merch is ordered; the print files are in Portuguese for the printer, waiting on Dinis's yes.

caught.line: The policy agent caught one agent overwriting another's key entry; the sealing tool was fixed within the hour.
caught.para: Also: the vault-key check went from 421 to 33 milliseconds, and the vault audit compares real values.

not-done.line: Stand-up decisions not written down, the RiskMandate core unowned, no check-ins, two decisions for Dinis.
not-done.para: Who may change a key entry, and who can sign as Dinis.

limits.line: The numbers are the team's own; nobody on the team is named; synthetic users tested designs, not people.

sources.line: The team's repository, its journalist's newsletter and 20:57 report, and board items.
